summary: Backend-only regression + new-feature tests for Gorgeous Fashion Boutique admin extensions. 33/33 pytest tests pass (22 prior regression + 11 new). All requested new features verified: GET /api/settings public returns logo_url + >=2 default hero_slides; POST /api/auth/change-password works (correct->200, wrong current->400, login with new succeeds, old fails, restore back to Gorgeous2025A verified); GET /api/reviews/all auth-gated and returns unapproved; PATCH /api/reviews/{id} approved=false hides from public list, approved=true restores; DELETE /api/reviews/{id} removes from DB; PATCH /api/settings persists hero_slides array (3 items round-trip) and logo_url (verified via subsequent GET).

minor.issue: No 404 when review_id does not exist (silently returns ok). Idempotent but hides client bugs.
No 404 when review_id does not exist (silently returns ok).
Accepts hero_slides as raw dicts without Pydantic validation of HeroSlide schema — invalid keys are stored as-is. Recommend validating with SiteSettings(**clean) or List[HeroSlide].
Does not invalidate existing JWTs after password change (token issued with old password still works until 12h expiry). Acceptable but worth documenting.

action_items: (Optional) Add 404 responses to PATCH/DELETE /api/reviews/{id} when document not found.
(Optional) Validate hero_slides items against HeroSlide model in PATCH /api/settings to drop unknown keys.
critical_code_review_comments: ChangePasswordRequest only enforces min_length=6 for new_password — consider stronger policy (mixed case + digit) before production.
PATCH /api/reviews/{id} and PATCH /api/settings accept raw dict — fields like 'approved' aren't type-checked; e.g. {approved: 'no'} would store the string 'no'. Use a typed Pydantic patch model.
Change password does not log an audit event nor force re-login on other sessions; consider rotating a token version / kid to invalidate old JWTs.
server.py is now ~520 lines — close to the 700 split threshold; plan to extract auth/reviews/settings into routers soon.
CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True is still spec-invalid (carry-over from iter 1).
test_credentials: admin1@gorgeousfashion.com / Gorgeous2025A (verified restored after change-password test), admin2/Gorgeous2025B, admin3/Gorgeous2025C — all working.
seed_data_creation: Test created/cleaned ephemeral reviews (TEST_AllRev, TEST_DelRev) and one hero_slides override that was reset to defaults at test end. Admin1 password mutated and restored within a single test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_gorgeous_api.py now covers 33 tests including all new admin features (change-password, reviews approve/hide/delete, hero_slides + logo_url settings persistence). All public + auth-gated paths verified. Frontend NOT tested per request. Admin1 password restoration is built into test_change_password_flow_then_restore — if that test ever fails partway through, manually re-seed by restarting backend (seed_admin updates hash if env value differs).
